nodes.name: Marcus tends lighthouse instruments
nodes.description: Marcus Calloway moves through the lighthouse watch room monitoring the instrument panels, revealing his pronounced limp.
evidence: Each step reveals a pronounced limp -- his RIGHT LEG drags with a soft scrape while his left lands firmly.
Below, in the watch room, MARCUS CALLOWAY (50s, weathered face, salt-and-pepper beard) moves between instrument panels.

nodes.name: Marcus logs weather conditions
nodes.description: Marcus sets down his tea, opens the logbook, and records or reviews the current wind speed and visibility.
evidence:
MARCUS
(murmuring)
Wind speed up two knots. Visibility holding at fourteen miles.
He carries a BLUE CERAMIC MUG of steaming tea. He sets the mug on the corner of a worn wooden desk and opens a logbook, running his finger along the day's entries.

nodes.name: Anchor responds to Marcus
nodes.description: Anchor, the black Labrador, wakes from his mat and signals alertness by thumping his tail.
evidence: Below the desk, a BLACK LABRADOR -- ANCHOR -- raises his broad head from a sleeping mat and thumps his tail against the stone floor.

nodes.name: Marcus notes Anchor senses storm
nodes.description: Marcus tells Anchor that the dog can already smell the approaching weather, underscoring the storm's arrival and their bond.
evidence:
MARCUS (CONT'D)
(to the dog)
You smell it already, don't you, Anchor. Good boy.

nodes.name: Marcus adjusts lighthouse rotation
nodes.description: Marcus limps to the window and manually adjusts the lighthouse rotation mechanism with practiced skill.
evidence: Marcus limps back to the window, his right leg stiff and dragging, and adjusts the rotation mechanism with practiced hands.

nodes.name: Marcus watches storm build
nodes.description: Marcus sits back down, drinks his tea, and watches the storm gathering on the horizon.
evidence: He resettles in his chair, lifts the blue mug, sips his tea, and watches the storm building on the horizon.

nodes.name: Marcus Calloway
nodes.description: A weathered lighthouse keeper with a pronounced limp who monitors instruments, logs conditions, adjusts the mechanism, and watches the approaching storm.
evidence: Marcus limps back to the window, his right leg stiff and dragging, and adjusts the rotation mechanism with practiced hands.
MARCUS CALLOWAY (50s, weathered face, salt-and-pepper beard) moves between instrument panels.

Marcus wears THICK-FRAMED READING GLASSES perched at the end of his nose.
